programme.desc: 民国八年,花钱捐得鹅城县长的马邦德携妻,师爷及随从走马上任,途中遭遇马贼张麻子一伙伏击,随从尽死,唯夫妻二人侥幸活命马邦德为保命,谎称自己是汤师爷,并声称自己身无分文,只有当上县长通过搜刮民脂民膏才有钱张麻子被汤师爷所说的诱人财富所动,便自己扮作县长带著手下赶赴鹅城上任

programme.title: 欧洲攻略粤普
programme.desc: 林在风和王朝英分别列为江湖第一人和江湖第二人,多年来无人能够撼动其地位而他们彼此亦敌亦友,相互欣赏又互相为敌世界顶级骇客听风者精心设计的地震飞弹上帝之手被神秘人苏菲偷走,美国CIA同时委派林在风和王朝英两人追查两人此次原本以为只是一场赏金猎手间的谋略较量,却在过程中救下了年轻黑客洛奇,引

programme.title: 加菲猫:勇闯世界粤
programme.desc: 全球知名大食懒家猫加菲猫(麦沛东 声演),每日足不出户享受外卖pizza和千层面,与及狗狗朋友阿的贴心的服侍一晚,当加菲准备食宵夜时,突然和阿的一起被神秘敌人绑架,因而意外与他失散多年,首次于大银幕现身的父亲 – 不羁流浪猫阿肥(林雪 声演)重聚加菲和阿的被迫跟上阿肥,展开疯狂惹笑又温馨满

programme.title: 有客到粤普
programme.desc: 以三段式灵异故事接合成的有客到,故事以殡仪业为背景

programme.title: 恶人谷粤
programme.desc: 狗狗之家慈善组织负责人查理四肢健全,却装作肌肉萎缩病患者骗取同情心,及进行各种卑鄙勾当而区内的世袭村长冯仁炳,恃著家中财雄势大,经常肆意用金钱买别人尊严,更骗取区中子弟的丁权福利冯仁炳被炳妈催促成婚,却一心找个可以狼狈为奸的女人做妻子有一天,来了一个五官标致的女子余真,原来她怀着城中富二

programme.title: 惊天救援普
programme.desc: 一场突如其来的地震波及整个灌城化工园区,管道泄漏触发爆炸不断浓烟滚滚,火光冲天,灾难迅速升级,如果任其蔓延,整座城市将被夷为平地面对要救火又要救人的严峻考验,消防救援站一众队员第一时间奔赴重灾区,危难时刻争分夺秒,用生命守护生命

programme.title: 黄大仙乌鼠粤普
programme.desc: 督察符永琳因贪污被检控, 往法庭途中越押, 逃回大陆, 被列作一号通缉犯两名女干探前往调查符的案件, 两个当年被符屈打成招的青年无意中碰上符, 决意报仇四人被符锁进一幢大厦内, 以便一一解决在紧要关头公安特种部队从天而降

programme.title: 抢钱夫妻粤普
programme.desc: 叙述新闻报道员蒋有为因患上绝症而引发一连串的家庭,事业,社会荒诞嘲讽

programme.title: 九降风普
programme.desc: 电影以9个高中生的青春成长故事为背景,这群血气方刚的灵魂不安地骚动著,他们以彼此对棒球的热爱结为死党,然而那段在球场上恣意呐喊的岁月,却似乎禁不住九月狂风的吹袭,在猜疑与背叛,性与暴力之间

programme.title: 极速僵尸粤普
programme.desc: 茅山术士茅龙苦练登神秘笈,欲成为长生不老天魔,得知大弟子佑土的妻子为六阴女,便欲将其生祭,吸其鲜血,佑土为保妻子飘红性命,与师弟合力对抗师父,结果成功将他镇封,多年后,茅龙爱徒无界为追寻六阴女下落

programme.title: 极速僵尸粤普
programme.desc: 茅山术士茅龙苦练登神秘笈,欲成为长生不老天魔,得知大弟子佑土的妻子为六阴女,便欲将其生祭,吸其鲜血,佑土为保妻子飘红性命,与师弟合力对抗师父,结果成功将他镇封,多年后,茅龙爱徒无界为追寻六阴女下落

programme.title: KANO日
programme.desc: 1929年,台湾嘉义出现了一支由日本大和民族,汉人和台湾原住民组成的嘉农棒球队新教练近藤兵太郎以进军甲子园为目标,实施斯巴达式的严格训练原本被日本人鄙视的这支散漫球队,在严格训练和屡屡挫败的刺激下,求胜意志与前进甲子园的决心渐渐被激发1931年,嘉农棒球队在台湾大会一路过关斩将,打败由日本人所组的常胜冠军台北商业队

programme.title: 初恋无限Touch粤普
programme.desc: 两个属于不同世界的年青男女,偶然相遇,结识,约会,然后相爱甜蜜中二人因小问题而冷战,和好之日却要面临两地分隔的考验究竟初恋情人能否付托终身呢?

programme.title: 妙探孖宝粤普
programme.desc: 私家侦探陆卓,为人自负,性格乐观,身手不凡富商许承天之独女嘉欣,自从十六岁那年开始便恶运缠身某日,嘉欣竟被人掳去,不知所踪,承天万分焦急,欲报警,却被继室莉莉和胞弟承坚阻止,遂决定聘请陆卓,寻觅嘉欣

programme.title: 五个吓鬼的少年粤普
programme.desc: 反叛青年佑(徐天佑饰)因想早日搬离家庭而到一古怪神秘大屋任职看更,还带同好友阿南(黄又南饰)及新结识的女孩Pricilla(李茏怡饰)到大屋壮胆,却意外发现大屋内竟然放著一古埃及千年木乃伊

programme.title: 唔该借歪粤普
programme.desc: 黑妈(叶德娴)为人口臭,说话刻薄,难与儿女和睦相处,唯有吹嘘有通灵的法力,寄居女儿Rosa(袁咏仪) 和女婿Dot Com(黄子华)家中,弄得笑话连篇直至黑妈发生意外,拥有真正的法力,她凭此将女儿和女婿身边的冤魂逐一驱散, 从中拾回亲人失落的感情

programme.title: 忠义群英粤普
programme.desc: 导演唐基明从不讳言忠勇群英是改编自黑泽明的七侠四义,只不过是把时代背景改为民初军阀割据年代,土匪刘林东抢掠穷村,村民聘请戚教头与大炮友,快刀手,狼牙榛,世界仔,轰天雷,神枪手等六名伟士抗贼七侠教村民使用枪械与埋地雷,设陷阱的抵御方法与原作一样,抗贼大战,七侠中四人牺牲,一人留下结婚,两人再踏征途

programme.title: 玉女添丁粤普
programme.desc: 安份守已无甚大志的广告公司小秘书周丽娟,被挑剔的女上司Monica无理解雇为求保住饭碗,丽娟竟然假装未婚有孕,公司基于保护孕妇雇员条例收回了解雇信

programme.title: 一见钟情粤普
programme.desc: 被丈夫遗弃在三藩市的失婚妇人Rosa,遇上玩世不恭的网络公司创办人Jimmy,两人一见钟情堕入爱河,不羁的Jimmy初时有点不惯,最终亦愿意跟Rosa同居但激情过后,大家发现各自有不同的世界观,不情不愿之下无奈分手一年之后,虽然Rosa和Jimmy仍爱对方,但自尊战胜爱情,两人都没抓紧机会复合

programme.title: PTU粤普
programme.desc: PTU警官展(任达华饰)与Kat(邵美琪饰)率领队员在尖沙咀进行反黑巡逻时,发现沙展肥沙(林雪饰)在餐厅外受袭,失去警枪展受肥沙所托,于天亮前把配枪找回,却引起PTU队员意见分岐

programme.title: 合家欢粤普
programme.desc: 居于海南岛乡村的雁归南,与远嫁香港的妹妹雁燕萍分离多年萍不时寄钱予南,南则把钱用来让村子铺路修桥,自己则过着捕渔,摘椰子的快活日子一日,南来到香港探望萍及妹夫黄嘉范,然而范一家人对南满怀偏见,认为南只懂累人累己果然,不谙港人文化的南处处闯祸,甚至破坏了范的妹妹黄嘉玲嫁入豪门的机会黄家越来越忍受不了南,萍处处维护也无济于事

programme.title: AV粤普
programme.desc: 世杰,阿华,明仔和老鼠还有几个月就要毕业离开大学了,因此他们踏入了一个将要离校但又未投身社会工作的迷茫期他们的一个中学同学阿乐,竟在临毕业前因(借拍戏沟女事件)被电影学院勒令退学

programme.title: 笑傲江湖之东方不败粤普
programme.desc: 华山大弟子令狐冲与师妹往野店与任盈盈会面,才得知盈及其父-日月教教主任我行同告失踪,而右使东方不败则暂代教主原来野心勃勃的东方不败获武林秘笈葵花宝典后,不惜自宫苦练,希望一统江湖,但外貌上却越发像女人模样

programme.title: 人皮灯笼粤普
programme.desc: 青年麦辉得古董表引指,进入一破落的旧楼中,竟有旧地重临之感,并带出三十年前一段哀怨缠绵的绝世恋情 - 辉与蓉本为一对恋人,黑邦头子雄爷对蓉唾涎,逼蓉献身以供淫虐,辉拼命救蓉,反遭雄乱刀杀死

programme.title: 醒狮粤普
programme.desc: 一日,阿鸡公司大裁员,人事部提出举行才艺表演,得到高层欢心者可留任阿鸡阿九自知全无专长可言舅公遂提议表演醒狮,原来阿鸡一家本为舞狮世家,惜港人对传统的舞狮兴趣日减,舅公只好无奈结束狮团,家传的醒狮亦只有藏在家中的灶底阿鸡与阿九见时间紧迫,即时发奋苦练

programme.title: Hide Seek (aka The Last Hide Seek)
programme.desc: 十三年前,废弃大厦的一场爆炸夺走了童的好友诺安。十三年后,童与昔日的朋友们重返故地,此地如今已成为他们就读的大学校园。当一名与诺安容貌相同的女孩出现,儿时的游戏化为索命的诅咒。复仇的恶灵再度苏醒,逐一

programme.title: 惊心妒怨
programme.desc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一间公寓式医院,不久后在深夜离奇坠楼身亡。坊间开始流传该医院是「幽灵医院」。事后,余虹敏的摄影师在深夜频频接到诡异电话,撰稿人在一场离奇车祸后神志不清,而她的好友则神秘失踪…

programme.title: Room For Rent
programme.desc: 寂寞的寡妇Joyce疯狂迷恋年轻的新租客。渴望得到爱情的她,为追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障碍,甚至要杀人灭口也在所不计!因而展开了一个令人毛骨悚然的迷恋故事 …

programme.title: 凌晨两点半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险,传说山中埋著千年女尸,千年不灭之阴火,进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半,依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间,依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间,更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: 玛莉因丈夫工作上的调迁,搬回位于郊区的家乡。当玛莉在新房子等候丈夫的时候,一个冰淇淋车杀手已把她视为下一个要杀掉的目标人物。此刻,玛莉发觉家乡已不如昔日般平静安宁…

programme.title: 无法无天飞车党

programme.title: 双镯
programme.desc: 两名少女作盟誓要在一个没有女权,甚或缺乏性自由的小渔村互相照顾一生。一位最终下嫁自己不认识的人,之后过著幸福快乐的日子。而另一位少女则惨遭许配给虐待成性的富家子,于是她唯有设法摆脱这个困境。

programme.title: 大杀手
programme.desc: 结义兄弟妹三人同闯江湖情意深,龙兄加入了缉私队,虎弟率直被人利用,小妹夹在中间做人难。

programme.title: 军阀趣史
programme.desc: 此片可谓李翰祥导演,经典作《大军阀》之延续,焦点在几位当时得令的艳星,余莎莉、邵音音及楚湘云。片中「艳趣」特别多…

programme.title: 铁手无情
programme.desc: 沧州捕头铁无情嫉恶如仇,先后击杀沧州剧盗。铁被盗首马威甲的夺魂笔所伤,混乱间,以马的坐骑突围而出,竟被送往马家,认识马双目失明的女儿桂姑。最后,铁与马于山上决战,马终伏法,铁返回桂姑身边。

programme.title: 女儿国
programme.desc: 本片讲述唐僧、孙悟空、猪八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取经,行至西梁女儿国,国内全是女人,而传宗接代生儿育女全靠「招胎泉」,饮过这泉水便可成孕,但也只能生女。

programme.title: 南少林与北少林
programme.desc: 满清入主中原后,北少林为免遭剿灭,只好受命派出弟子到清军府担任教头,谁知抵达后,始知府中已有南少林教头;期间将军挑动两派人不和继而公开比武互相残杀,后南派因弟子伤亡而与北派交恶,展开一番互相残杀

programme.title: 愤怒青年
programme.desc: 沈昌生性沉郁,与父亲缺乏沟通,被人利用,误入歧途。昌逃不过暴力的魔爪和色情的引诱,竟然出卖父亲,让父亲惨死。昌悲悔交加,独闯飞仔巢,逐一将之击毙,自已也进入疯狂状态。

programme.title: 蔡李佛小子
programme.desc: 年青马车伕钟坚因救助少女而与恶霸结怨。马车老板恐惹祸上身,把他辞退。钟坚决志除暴安良,随少林蔡李佛名家习武,向恶势力挑战。最后,他将恶霸除掉,令地方归于平静。

programme.title: 乾隆皇奇遇记
programme.desc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡,希望借此了解百姓的生活需要,但却碰上连串的奇遇,乾隆更被衙差关进牢狱,差点要被斩首…最后又有谁可拯救皇帝出困境?

programme.title: 江湖汉子
programme.desc: 林少游、石大勇及关飞,三者俱属浪迹江湖之豪侠,表面上游戏人间,实则满怀壮志,誓以抗暴为己任。一次,机缘恰巧,林等三人助青年富户楚铁侠逃出险境,并结为生死之交。元朝异族王爷早有霸占富户财富的野心,后更借故追捕楚,林等遂出手相助,共谋抗暴大业

programme.title: 铁扇公主
programme.desc: 一段紧张奇情的取西经故事,由孙悟空师徒行经火焰山,大战铁扇公主,白骨精及其妹妹展开。

programme.title: 阿牛出狱记
programme.desc: 续集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛,当中不少更是笑中有泪的经历。阿牛出狱后,再遇爱人阿花,可惜她已嫁为人妻;另一方面,戆直的阿牛仍不断被狡猾的周大叔欺骗

programme.title: 青春鼓王
programme.desc: 船员孙志强巧合成为「火花大乐队」的鼓手,他因急于成名,答应帮助音乐杂志出版人李源明接近乐队经理黄丽真,以换取源明的力捧。终于,志强得偿所愿,一炮而红,源明却逼他实践诺言,与丽真断绝来往。志强受到极大打击,唯有忍痛离开乐队与丽真

programme.desc: 丁安安与雍晴两个表姐妹自小就读于同一所女校,因二人的母亲一向口和心不和,从小就向自己女儿灌输好胜思想,因此形成安安与晴从小斗到大,三日一小吵,五日一大斗。她们在校中认识了男同学米高及保罗,很快成为情侣,两对小冤家后来因斗气竟然互调了男朋友…

programme.title: 断魂谷
programme.desc: 断魂谷赵家庄主赵云阳有两弟子,赵玉龙和赵剑英。玉龙终年浪荡江湖,却得云阳所有财产。剑英不愤,害死师父嫁祸玉龙,幷引其子金虎追杀玉龙。两人在断魂谷决斗,剑英欲收渔人之利,幸金虎和玉龙发现谷中有埋伏,诈伤引出主谋,连手反攻

programme.title: 云泥
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受机师男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症,一天巧遇留学归来的精神科医生黎易非,多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素卷入三角恋和复杂的内心纠结之中。

programme.title: 清宫大刺杀

programme.title: 三十年细说从头

programme.title: 侠士行

programme.title: 刺马

programme.title: 乾隆下扬州

programme.title: 妖魂

programme.title: 中华丈夫

programme.title: 玫瑰我爱你

programme.title: 射雕英雄传续集

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #4 英普

programme.title: 朝暮动物志 #5 英普
programme.desc: 热带太平洋生活中的一天。在小岛上,科莫多巨蜥争夺食物残渣,而招潮蟹则在海滩上决斗。在海底,蝠鲼于深海滑翔,奇特的行走鲨鱼在色彩斑斓的珊瑚礁中巡逻。

programme.title: 狝猴岛 #1 英普
programme.desc: 穿梭于绿意盎然的城市,狝猴族长马特诺尔以铁腕手段,一直统治拥有30名成员的街头部族。另一边厢,老领袖阿拉夫则管理更具野性的深山部族。年少气盛的洛基该挑战哪一位的王者宝座?

programme.title: 狝猴岛 #2 英普
programme.desc: 跟随街头部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充满垃圾食物的城市假期。镜头一转,看看深山部族趁机入侵街头部族的领地后,情势如何急转直下。目击姐妹团如何组织绑架莎拉宝宝的阴谋,而新上任的领袖洛基则发现他的老对手已经重返城镇。

programme.title: 不羁尚比亚 #3 英普
programme.desc: 随著旱季开始,成千上万的动物正前往相思环。每头动物都必须在捕食顺序中确立自己的位置,避免那些非常愿意以粗心的动物作大餐的危险居民。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #8 英普
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命线,尤其是在酷热难耐的旱季,宝贵的水分几乎难以寻觅。深入探索并了解各式各样能展翅飞翔的生物,无论是鸟类还是蝙蝠,牠们在缺水的漫长日子里,善加运用并精打细算管理仅有的资源,直到雨季降临、甘甜的雨水带来久违的慰藉与舒缓。

programme.desc: 这是澳洲春季的第一天,从风流的树熊到拳击袋鼠,再到选择今天开餐令人惊讶地快速的眼斑巨蜥,独特的动物们就开始春日狂热。

programme.title: 马拉威野生拯救队 #5
programme.desc: 一只穿山甲被野生动物贩运者虐待致死,阿曼达博士的团队感到心碎,但另一只穿山甲在康复后归野,则令他们雀跃万分。检查三只刺猬,跟随中心的狒狒和安氏林羚转换住处。

programme.title: 马拉威野生拯救队 #6
programme.desc: 准备观看阿曼达博士冒险尝试给野马羚套上颈圈。然后,长尾猴发生骚乱,因此要追踪蓝冕狐猴- 阿蓝。检查一只长了趾瘤的雕鸮,然后向即将返回野外的鳄鱼希拉说再见。

programme.title: 不羁尚比亚 #4 英普
programme.desc: 毛拉是麦兹家族中最年轻的小牛。随著气温飙升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭。逼使毛拉和牠的家人进行一次漫长而危险的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源: 卢安瓜河。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #9 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河之旅的最后一个国家是湄公河三角洲的发源地。大量营养丰富的物质从数百里外的河流顺流而下,使此地成为越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物宝库。

programme.title: 马拉威野生拯救队 #5

programme.title: 马拉威野生拯救队 #6
programme.desc: 准备观看阿曼达博士冒险尝试给野马羚套上颈圈。然后,长尾猴发生骚乱,因此要追踪蓝冕狐猴- 阿蓝。检查一只长了趾瘤的雕鸮,然后向即将返回野外的鳄鱼希拉说再见。

programme.title: 不羁尚比亚 #4 英普
programme.desc: 毛拉是麦兹家族中最年轻的小牛。随著气温飙升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭。逼使毛拉和牠的家人进行一次漫长而危险的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源: 卢安瓜河。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #9 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河之旅的最后一个国家是湄公河三角洲的发源地。大量营养丰富的物质从数百里外的河流顺流而下,使此地成为越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物宝库。

programme.title: 狝猴岛 #1 英普
programme.desc: 穿梭于绿意盎然的城市,狝猴族长马特诺尔以铁腕手段,一直统治拥有30名成员的街头部族。另一边厢,老领袖阿拉夫则管理更具野性的深山部族。年少气盛的洛基该挑战哪一位的王者宝座?

programme.title: 狝猴岛 #2 英普
programme.desc: 跟随街头部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充满垃圾食物的城市假期。镜头一转,看看深山部族趁机入侵街头部族的领地后,情势如何急转直下。目击姐妹团如何组织绑架莎拉宝宝的阴谋,而新上任的领袖洛基则发现他的老对手已经重返城镇。

programme.title: 朝暮动物志 #6 英普
programme.desc: 这是澳洲春季的第一天,从风流的树熊到拳击袋鼠,再到选择今天开餐令人惊讶地快速的眼斑巨蜥,独特的动物们就开始春日狂热。

programme.title: 城市野生拯救队 #5
programme.desc: 这部12集的纪录片系列将显示哪些动物居住在城市中,以及牠们遇到了甚么麻烦。当牠们需要帮助时,一队拯救队将会出动。每年有成千上万的动物获得新生,只因志愿者和专业人士一同为热爱的大自然出力。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #3 英普
programme.desc: 如果小小的恩塞富狮群想要生存下去,族群中一对不合群的兄弟必须迅速掌握狩猎技巧,并要快速穿梭于敌人领地中,与霸气的竞争对手和强大的鬣狗群作战,以得着温饱。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #4 英普
programme.desc: 一起来认识小雌豹奇帕祖亚的魅力,她受到母亲的悉心照顾,因此从未需要自己捕猎。这是她生命中第一次独自生活,她能否绝地求生,培养出所需的狩猎技能?

programme.title: 朝暮动物志 #4 英普
programme.desc: 印度次大陆的母亲节象征旱季于斯里兰卡开始,同时于印度结束。对于一只孟加拉虎妈妈来说,是时候训练她的幼崽去狩猎了,而狮子和眼镜蛇则忙于交配。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #8 英普
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命线,尤其是在酷热难耐的旱季,宝贵的水分几乎难以寻觅。深入探索并了解各式各样能展翅飞翔的生物,无论是鸟类还是蝙蝠,牠们在缺水的漫长日子里,善加运用并精打细算管理仅有的资源,直到雨季降临、甘甜的雨水带来久违的慰藉与舒缓。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #3
programme.desc: 义工们在本集近距离接触标志性的动物。深入了解韦札的反偷猎成就。还有,努力无坚不摧。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #4
programme.desc: 义工们探索社区在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人兴奋的蜂蜜收成、新团员的加入,以及其中一人喂哺黑犀牛的梦想成真。

programme.title: 大白鲨的秘密
programme.desc: 鲨鱼是怪物吗?还是已经被妖魔化?这部纪录片探讨大白鲨本性背后的真相。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #1
programme.desc: 领略纳米比亚千公里的狂野海岸!干旱沙漠中生命顽强绽放,本片捕捉了万物在极端环境下生存的壮丽奇景。一同见证超越极限的生命之美!

programme.title: 自然保护区 #2
programme.desc: 从落基山脉到太平洋,英属哥伦比亚是生物多样性的瑰宝!在辽阔大地追随灰熊的霸气身影。这是一片庄严且神圣、亟需我们守护的原始荒野!

programme.title: 街头美食通 #7
programme.desc: 安斯利发现马德里是个充满秘密的城市。首先这个沉迷美食的城市禁止街头美食。那么当地人如何绕过这道禁令呢?

programme.title: 街头美食通 #8
programme.desc: 安斯利来到摩洛哥,但他没有去马拉喀什或卡萨布兰加,而是去了丰富多彩、混乱而梦幻的费兹。杂乱无序的麦地那是世界遗产,也是通往另一个时代的门户。

programme.title: 街头美食通 #9
programme.desc: 安斯利到访槟岛首都乔治敦,马来西亚人发现这个沉迷美食的国家中最好的街头食品。

programme.title: 芭比的故事
programme.desc: 芭比娃娃在2024年庆祝65岁生日。但她不仅是一块12英寸长的塑胶或一个玩具。 这位传奇金发美女已成为一种现象和小孩们的宠儿。

programme.title: ABBA乐团: 欧洲歌唱大赛后的半世纪
programme.desc: 从头记录ABBA由欧洲歌唱大赛到崛起成全球巨星、他们标志性的嗓音、破纪录的成功、单飞的努力、ABBA精选唱片- Gold的复苏,以及先进的全息投影巡演- 《启航》,乐队以虚拟形式重聚。

programme.title: 珍娜·杰克森: 诱惑的艺术
programme.desc: 珍妮积逊以其强烈的独立性、有吸力的气质和迷人的嗓音而闻名,她在MTV的成长成为她的催化剂;接受她的身份,并到达明星的巅峰。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #6
programme.desc: 本集探索大自然中最顽强的动物如何适应地球上一些最恶劣环境中的极端条件。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #7
programme.desc: 我们在本集将探索动物的沟通以及难以置信的适应能力,并揭示动物间能够「交谈」。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #8
programme.desc: 研究大自然动物中的交际花,揭示因同居而演化出的令人惊讶和难以置信的行为。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9
programme.desc: 展示大自然一些最难以置信的动物头脑,牠们的大脑显现出高智慧,使牠们能在竞争中取得优势。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我们在本集探讨动物为何及如何战斗,并揭示牠们天生不惜一切生存下来的方法。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #1
programme.desc: 随著日照越短、天气越寒冷,加拿大的野生动物正与时间竞赛,任何无法好好利用秋天作准备的动物都将灭亡。

programme.title: 太空灾难 #6

programme.title: 俯瞰义大利 #3
programme.desc: 它们的形状和大小各适其适,是可怕的火山、伟大的古代文明,还有地球上最清澈水域的家。它们就是迷人的义大利岛国。

programme.title: 太空灾难 #4

programme.title: 太空灾难 #5
programme.desc: 在恶劣的天气中飞行是令人痛苦的经验,而对于美国太空总署来说,可说是倍感不安,因为凶猛的风暴可以不分大气层上下袭来。

programme.title: 太空灾难 #6

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅从南岛西岸展开。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座农场遇见了全纽西兰唯一的蔓越莓生产者,接著前往布莱克波尔(Blackball)学习腊肠(chorizo)的制作过程。Ben 随后在海滩上烹调出多道结合这些在地美味的料理,并搭配当地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 来到坎特伯里的高峰牧场,了解这座高地农场「从产地到餐桌」的体验,以及家族世代守护土地的故事。接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜访一对以永续方式采集海鲜的夫妇——他们以推土机将渔船推进大海,展开一天的捕捞旅程。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #3
programme.desc: Ben 来到黑斯廷斯,发现当地以整合式的全方位方法生产草饲安格斯牛肉。他造访在地农夫市集,认识了许多优秀的本地食品生产者,展现出这个地区丰饶的农产品。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #4
programme.desc: Ben 拜访了一位果园经营者与食品创新专家。他们共同的愿景是制作天然、以品种为主导的苹果汁,并采用世界最先进的技术。他也参观了位于霍克斯湾地中海型气候下所培育的超过三十种无花果。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡罗瓦的一座鲑鱼养殖场,了解纽西兰帝王鲑与大西洋鲑的不同之处。他亲自捕捞鲑鱼,并在俯瞰港湾的海岸边烹调。他也介绍了一款高品质的本地食用油,兼具健康与多功能性,体现对本地农业与永续的承诺。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛产季节!Ben 造访中奥塔哥一个由家族经营的果园,该果园以核果产季长、与土地及社区的紧密连结而闻名。他发现了一座全电力运作的樱桃农场,将优质外销樱桃直接贩售给纽西兰民众。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 体验鲁阿佩胡地区正崛起的饮食文化,以及悠久的市集园艺历史。他拜访了一位第六代农夫,该农夫将一片偏远荒野打造成繁荣的生态旅游与高级餐饮目的地,并与一位屡获殊荣的主厨合作。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 来到坎特伯里的高峰牧场,了解这座高地农场「从产地到餐桌」的体验,以及家族世代守护土地的故事。接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜访一对以永续方式采集海鲜的夫妇——他们以推土机将渔船推进大海,展开一天的捕捞旅程。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #3
programme.desc: Ben 来到黑斯廷斯,发现当地以整合式的全方位方法生产草饲安格斯牛肉。他造访在地农夫市集,认识了许多优秀的本地食品生产者,展现出这个地区丰饶的农产品。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #4
programme.desc: Ben 拜访了一位果园经营者与食品创新专家。他们共同的愿景是制作天然、以品种为主导的苹果汁,并采用世界最先进的技术。他也参观了位于霍克斯湾地中海型气候下所培育的超过三十种无花果。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡罗瓦的一座鲑鱼养殖场,了解纽西兰帝王鲑与大西洋鲑的不同之处。他亲自捕捞鲑鱼,并在俯瞰港湾的海岸边烹调。他也介绍了一款高品质的本地食用油,兼具健康与多功能性,体现对本地农业与永续的承诺。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛产季节!Ben 造访中奥塔哥一个由家族经营的果园,该果园以核果产季长、与土地及社区的紧密连结而闻名。他发现了一座全电力运作的樱桃农场,将优质外销樱桃直接贩售给纽西兰民众。

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
高朋满座#75粤
programme.desc: 朋上班途中遇上一代厨神刀哥突出现向朋说教，原来有「厨魔」之称的庄天武将会来港，更下战书指名要挑战朋厨艺。信心十足的朋竟不将挑战放于心，继续日常生活。朋巧遇一位老人，他于朋面前弄了一锅茶叶蛋后从容离去。

programme.title: 尚食#15粤普
programme.desc: 子衿画的辋川图落入月华之手，月华以瓜果菜蔬将辋川图景再现，巧夺天工，却因不合时宜和触犯忌讳而落败，子衿和紫萍则以一道二十四节气馄饨，赢得皇后赞赏。游园之日，瞻基品食时尝出子衿做的菜式，表现出不高兴。

programme.title: 阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 本地稻田已买少见少，鼎爷、阿谭下田体验割禾、打谷等步骤。鼎爷用鸡壳、陈皮煲煮香滑粥底，奉上荔湾家乡美食「艇仔粥」。除了基本的水鱿鱼、猪皮外，加入鲜虾、猪柳等食材令味道再「升呢」！主持们及后深入腐乳工场，见识传统天然发酵腐乳的制作工序。二人还会分别用腐乳捞饭、涂多士，原来都喜欢加糖来中和咸味。不同部位的排骨各有口感，鼎爷选用嫩滑的一字排，炮制香脆的「腐乳炸排骨」。猪肉本身含有油分，为何还要用油腌制？

programme.title: 才骏Hashtag 瑞银认股证牛熊证粤
流行都市粤
programme.desc: 香港正面临人口急速老化的挑战，安老服务尤为重要。安老服务协会代表到来，述说行业正面对照顾者人手短缺、少数害群之马影响形象等问题。长者入住院舍后或难以适应，院舍如何协助？大王、菲比这回随邓达智品尝中菜，「招牌片皮鹅」鸭皮酥脆，并带有甘香的鹅油；阿拉斯加蟹分别用牛油焗、鸡油蒸，一蟹吃出两种滋味；用藤椒碎蒸海上鲜，以麻辣味带出鱼香。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，许美德师傅示范一道「潮州椒酱肉」，香口惹味！

programme.title: 医度讲粤
programme.desc: 别以为只有肥胖人士才会有脂肪肝出现！研究显示，全球大约每四名成人就有一人有非酒精脂肪肝。《医度讲》这集有内分泌及糖尿专科胡依诺医生、注册中医师何慧欣与李澄琳营养师，以及非常注重肝脏健康的艺人黄庭锋，探讨与解构「脂肪肝」的成因和治疗方法，也会向观众推荐预防食疗。

programme.title: 才骏Hashtag 瑞银认股证牛熊证粤
五味人生#7粤
programme.desc: 双春认为永祯所用的手法旁门左道，却无法阻止。胜天向永祯诉苦，说监察修桥补路的工程令他苦闷不已，永祯教胜天应把金凤追到手后才抛弃她以作报复。胜天的保镖之科到洋货店找金凤，更代胜天邀约她翌日饭聚……双春偕九妹拜访飞扬，希望飞扬能收九妹为徒却遭他婉拒。飞扬遇若岚得知她欲到溪间捉鱼，于是抛下俗务陪伴师妹。所长指喜相逢以不道德手法经营突然查封酒楼。双春因而指摘永祯，但关老太反而支持他；双春忍不住大发脾气……

programme.title: 偶像星愿7 Third BEAT!粤日
programme.desc: 来到MOP当日，成海对奖项仍然有偏见，但听过IDOLiSH7和TRIGGER的赛前访问后开始动摇。两队男团先后在台上演唱新歌，精彩表演迷倒现场观众和网民，大家开始踊跃投票，最后由TRIGGER以些微差距压过IDOLiSH7赢得大奖。

programme.title: Hands Up粤

programme.desc: 李成战败，依梅便离家去找他，令白先生身体日渐衰弱。依梅在路上遭士兵调戏，幸得紫轩相救，更把她送到李成的府上；二人感动相聚并成亲。平原去找依梅，让她回去看望白先生，途中却被抓进牢房，原来这是紫轩的计划…

programme.title: 试真D粤
programme.desc: 双月湾有海鲜餐厅表明团购餐畀冰鲜料，力推时价海鲜，团队来个大对比！团餐除了有翻叮炒饭、冻炒花甲，椒盐濑尿虾亦霉霉黑黑。然而最离谱是新鲜黄金贝，竟冻夹腥？向店方反映后，下一道汤品似有古怪，主持埋单速逃！海景公寓的满分点评竟没提及房间，难道有伏？约130人民币的套房被揭床舖、热水炉等问题，曾展望却称醉人海景已值回票价。地道小店老板有「冷战式」待客之道，足料炖汤、肠粉亦够温度，美仪姐随嘉洛探店却被惊吓？

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
及时雨信贷呈献：谈判专家#7粤
programme.desc: 家聪车祸受伤，文静慰问。文静暗中送礼物给家聪庆祝周年纪念。杨光与可人顺利过关，正式成为谈判专家。家全喜欢可人，可人不知所措，遂找杨光假装情侣，家全大受打击，再萌自杀念头，可人与杨光开解家全，令家全不再以自杀来获取别人关心。简洁知家聪于餐厅订了情侣晚餐，悉心打扮，但家聪谎称要工作未能相陪。及后简洁发现家聪衫袋内有该餐厅收据，简洁开始怀疑。家聪与简洁往油站入油，职员认错简洁为另一女子，简洁的疑心更大。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 地中海贫血是遗传性疾病，患者容易出现贫血，重症者更要终身输血及定时服用除铁药物。血液及血液肿瘤科医生指，骨髓移植是现时主流根治方法，近年推行的基因治疗亦有不错成效。树艺师肩负诊断与维护城市树木的责任，被称为「树木医生」。树艺师兼攀树师到来，概述二者的工作分别，并提到日常需面对日晒雨淋的辛劳。嘉宾更和同行创办攀树比赛，希望向公众推广这项专业。「睇𩠌食饭」，傅季馨师傅带来「咖哩牛肉焗薯仔」，嫩滑惹味！

programme.title: 医度讲粤
programme.desc: 你睡觉时，会「打鼻鼾」吗？你晚上有否因呼吸不顺畅而影响睡眠质素？你可能患上「睡眠窒息症」！这集有受到疑似此症影响的艺人朋友何广沛到来，请教内分泌及糖尿料胡依诺医生、注册中医师何慧欣与李澄琳营养师有关睡眠窒息症的成因及治疗方法，并即场面诊！

programme.title: 五味人生#9粤
programme.desc: 飞扬完成五色炒饭，若岚果然忆起了不少昔日事情。双春把看见飞扬煮菜的技巧全都告诉九妹，九妹试煮，众人大赞好味。若岚胡乱用方法欲替自己治病险象横生；双春只得再拜托飞扬煮菜却被推辞。飞扬的太太婉君努力下，飞扬终答应替若岚煮菜。胜天向父亲提出办慈善舞会，替义学筹经费。镇长为选出谁主理舞会膳食，让喜相逢与吉庆楼作厨艺比试；飞扬更答应九妹能在比赛中胜出，便收他为徒。双春灵机一触，想到在山中及海边猎取野味作菜。

programme.title: 高朋满座#77粤
programme.desc: 大会安排二人进行厨艺比赛前哨战，朋无奈答应，但天武的厨艺实技高一筹。天武表明早已厌倦比赛生活，求朋一起放弃决战。庆看出他们在意比赛，劝服二人比拼。二人出尽法宝煮出最得意的菜色，惜二人参赛只是宣传技俩。

programme.title: 尚食#17粤普
programme.desc: 卫王浪费食物，子衿希望他学会珍惜食物，卫王听不进耳，还想抓子衿出气；苏月华在一帆的帮助下到御前侍奉；她投皇帝所好制膳，使皇帝食用过多荤腥导致流鼻血，郭贵妃知道苏月华为了上位不择手段，想废掉她的双手…

programme.title: Do姐有问题粤PG
programme.desc: 清迈有炸鸡师傅每天将手放进沸油中，他受了甚么刺激？有何方法令一颗朱古力升价百倍？卢觅雪、阮兆祥为分甘同味，企图自制打和赛果，可惜在祥仔旁边的是被形容为「没带脑上班」的C君，祥仔最终能否尝到黑松露美食？

programme.title: Do姐有问题粤PG
programme.desc: 单立文偕妻子胡蓓蔚担任嘉宾，不停发放笑弹，引得Do姐对他们的相处方式大感好奇。秘鲁青蛙汁有何功效？东京一间没有厨师的食店，食物从何而来？台湾面店老板为何炮制分量足够十人食用的「大碗面」？

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫经商失败！崔明吉调包财阀孙女只为让女儿入豪门】琴英淑是一位爱女心切的母亲，性格温厚，在丈夫生意失败时，她也从不抱怨，自愿到殷会长的家里担任管家。女儿京慧出生时便被诊断出心脏疾病，当时家境也很难提供好的医疗资源。在一场车祸中，她意外的将女儿京慧，与财阀孙女世妍互相掉包身分，本该是千金小姐的世妍也因此变为平凡人，在百货担任精品店职员，而京慧更是直接跃升为财团富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，发现原本属于她的富贵人生全被京慧夺走，愤怒之下她改名换姓，决定拿回属于她的一切。

programme.title: 优雅的朋友们
programme.desc: 【夫妇的世界「升级版」！初恋女神现身揭开五人帮隐藏面具】一场离奇猝死与密室谋杀，撕裂大学「五人帮」维持二十年的体面假象。死党万植离世，失踪多年的初恋海淑突然现身，唤醒男人们被西装掩盖的欲望与罪恶。模范人夫宫哲察觉妻子静海疑似出轨，威胁她的教练却随即身亡，监视器与证物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到绝境的妻子、病态迷恋的死党，谁在说谎？当秘密层层揭开，每个人都是嫌疑犯，谁才是最终的杀人凶手？

programme.title: 暖阳之下
programme.desc: 【温馨陆剧/二宝＆事业该选谁？ 都市夫妻的两难抉择！】宋思凝怀著梦想只身来到北京，经过多年打拼终于成为公司的人力总监，与创意公司总经理李俊龙成为夫妻，并育有一儿，日子过得幸福美满。但在婚育观上，两人的想法有极大的分歧，经常为了女儿的教育问题争吵，李俊龙希望能与思凝生育二宝，然而正值事业上升期的思凝，面临自我实现与家庭的两难冲突，在大都会生活的两人又该如何抉择呢？

programme.title: 白夜童话
programme.desc: 【《绅士与小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飙复仇抛夫弃子生母】从小遭母亲抛弃，加上父亲早逝，白夜与哥哥相依为命，性格坚强好胜的她总对哥哥百般依赖，也因嫉妒哥哥与大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁难怀孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分头疼。某天哥哥与生母连络上，面对母亲拒绝相认，哥哥内心大受打击，一晃神就因交通意外不幸离世，得知此事的白夜便将所有愤怒转向母亲，展开一系列的报复计划。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 先热情地打扫吧
programme.desc: 【《红天机》金裕贞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹钧相，上演元气女与洁癖男的浪漫喜剧！！】立志消灭所有细菌，把清洁视为人类崇高使命，拒绝与他人肌肤接触，无法忍受灰尘，经营清洁公司的洁癖执行长张善杰。遇上外表邋遢个性不拘小节的四次元少女吉五雪，毕业后的首份就业工作，努力完成员工清洁使命。极与极相遇的浪漫爱情喜剧。

programme.title: 君九龄
programme.desc: 九龄公主生性善良，喜好医术，一场阴谋使得她失去至亲，骨肉分离，容貌大变。为了查清真相报仇雪恨，九龄隐姓埋名一直蛰伏，靠著坚强的毅力和意志力，苦练技艺，不放过任何蛛丝马迹，最终发现这场阴谋背后还有一段不为人知的皇室辛秘。知晓真相后的九龄，回到京城，在凶手不断的骚扰和攻击中建立了医馆九龄堂，济世救人，受人尊崇。与此同时，朱瓒与清贵公子宁云钊、前夫陆云旗、方家独子方承宇，身份各异、关系复杂的四人，陷入了以九龄为核心的感情漩涡。谁才是九龄的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 两个人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞书欣锁定张彬彬，小太阳系女孩专治万年冰山。恋爱正在发芽中！！】时尚美妆部落客虞美人，外表光鲜亮丽，却始终放不下大学时期暗恋对象植物学教授庄羽。一次命运重逢，让她决定重新展开追爱计划。理性寡言的他，却对这位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐渐敞开心扉。从城市学校到乡村社会，从误解到理解，在一片绿意中，共筑属于彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治愈、慢慢相爱。

programme.title: 先热情地打扫吧
programme.desc: 【《红天机》金裕贞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹钧相，上演元气女与洁癖男的浪漫喜剧！！】立志消灭所有细菌，把清洁视为人类崇高使命，拒绝与他人肌肤接触，无法忍受灰尘，经营清洁公司的洁癖执行长张善杰。遇上外表邋遢个性不拘小节的四次元少女吉五雪，毕业后的首份就业工作，努力完成员工清洁使命。极与极相遇的浪漫爱情喜剧。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 君九龄
programme.desc: 九龄公主生性善良，喜好医术，一场阴谋使得她失去至亲，骨肉分离，容貌大变。为了查清真相报仇雪恨，九龄隐姓埋名一直蛰伏，靠著坚强的毅力和意志力，苦练技艺，不放过任何蛛丝马迹，最终发现这场阴谋背后还有一段不为人知的皇室辛秘。知晓真相后的九龄，回到京城，在凶手不断的骚扰和攻击中建立了医馆九龄堂，济世救人，受人尊崇。与此同时，朱瓒与清贵公子宁云钊、前夫陆云旗、方家独子方承宇，身份各异、关系复杂的四人，陷入了以九龄为核心的感情漩涡。谁才是九龄的真命天子？

programme.title: 森林侦探
programme.desc: 韩国教育电视台EBS制作的寓教于乐卡通，可轻松认识大自然的样貌。神秘事件在森林里发生，栗子莫名消失，昆虫朋友离奇失踪，皮特、巴巴、茉莉对这些事件展开调查。带著侦探精神一起度过难关，在繁忙的调查过程中，共同学习、共同成长，创造学习乐趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫经商失败！崔明吉调包财阀孙女只为让女儿入豪门】琴英淑是一位爱女心切的母亲，性格温厚，在丈夫生意失败时，她也从不抱怨，自愿到殷会长的家里担任管家。女儿京慧出生时便被诊断出心脏疾病，当时家境也很难提供好的医疗资源。在一场车祸中，她意外的将女儿京慧，与财阀孙女世妍互相掉包身分，本该是千金小姐的世妍也因此变为平凡人，在百货担任精品店职员，而京慧更是直接跃升为财团富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，发现原本属于她的富贵人生全被京慧夺走，愤怒之下她改名换姓，决定拿回属于她的一切。

programme.title: 优雅的朋友们
programme.desc: 【夫妇的世界「升级版」！初恋女神现身揭开五人帮隐藏面具】一场离奇猝死与密室谋杀，撕裂大学「五人帮」维持二十年的体面假象。死党万植离世，失踪多年的初恋海淑突然现身，唤醒男人们被西装掩盖的欲望与罪恶。模范人夫宫哲察觉妻子静海疑似出轨，威胁她的教练却随即身亡，监视器与证物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到绝境的妻子、病态迷恋的死党，谁在说谎？当秘密层层揭开，每个人都是嫌疑犯，谁才是最终的杀人凶手？

programme.title: 暖阳之下
programme.desc: 【温馨陆剧/二宝＆事业该选谁？ 都市夫妻的两难抉择！】宋思凝怀著梦想只身来到北京，经过多年打拼终于成为公司的人力总监，与创意公司总经理李俊龙成为夫妻，并育有一儿，日子过得幸福美满。但在婚育观上，两人的想法有极大的分歧，经常为了女儿的教育问题争吵，李俊龙希望能与思凝生育二宝，然而正值事业上升期的思凝，面临自我实现与家庭的两难冲突，在大都会生活的两人又该如何抉择呢？

programme.title: 白夜童话
programme.desc: 【《绅士与小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飙复仇抛夫弃子生母】从小遭母亲抛弃，加上父亲早逝，白夜与哥哥相依为命，性格坚强好胜的她总对哥哥百般依赖，也因嫉妒哥哥与大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁难怀孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分头疼。某天哥哥与生母连络上，面对母亲拒绝相认，哥哥内心大受打击，一晃神就因交通意外不幸离世，得知此事的白夜便将所有愤怒转向母亲，展开一系列的报复计划。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 先热情地打扫吧
programme.desc: 【《红天机》金裕贞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹钧相，上演元气女与洁癖男的浪漫喜剧！！】立志消灭所有细菌，把清洁视为人类崇高使命，拒绝与他人肌肤接触，无法忍受灰尘，经营清洁公司的洁癖执行长张善杰。遇上外表邋遢个性不拘小节的四次元少女吉五雪，毕业后的首份就业工作，努力完成员工清洁使命。极与极相遇的浪漫爱情喜剧。

programme.title: 君九龄
programme.desc: 九龄公主生性善良，喜好医术，一场阴谋使得她失去至亲，骨肉分离，容貌大变。为了查清真相报仇雪恨，九龄隐姓埋名一直蛰伏，靠著坚强的毅力和意志力，苦练技艺，不放过任何蛛丝马迹，最终发现这场阴谋背后还有一段不为人知的皇室辛秘。知晓真相后的九龄，回到京城，在凶手不断的骚扰和攻击中建立了医馆九龄堂，济世救人，受人尊崇。与此同时，朱瓒与清贵公子宁云钊、前夫陆云旗、方家独子方承宇，身份各异、关系复杂的四人，陷入了以九龄为核心的感情漩涡。谁才是九龄的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 两个人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞书欣锁定张彬彬，小太阳系女孩专治万年冰山。恋爱正在发芽中！！】时尚美妆部落客虞美人，外表光鲜亮丽，却始终放不下大学时期暗恋对象植物学教授庄羽。一次命运重逢，让她决定重新展开追爱计划。理性寡言的他，却对这位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐渐敞开心扉。从城市学校到乡村社会，从误解到理解，在一片绿意中，共筑属于彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治愈、慢慢相爱。

programme.desc: 【《红天机》金裕贞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹钧相，上演元气女与洁癖男的浪漫喜剧！！】立志消灭所有细菌，把清洁视为人类崇高使命，拒绝与他人肌肤接触，无法忍受灰尘，经营清洁公司的洁癖执行长张善杰。遇上外表邋遢个性不拘小节的四次元少女吉五雪，毕业后的首份就业工作，努力完成员工清洁使命。极与极相遇的浪漫爱情喜剧。

programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 两个人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞书欣锁定张彬彬，小太阳系女孩专治万年冰山。恋爱正在发芽中！！】时尚美妆部落客虞美人，外表光鲜亮丽，却始终放不下大学时期暗恋对象植物学教授庄羽。一次命运重逢，让她决定重新展开追爱计划。理性寡言的他，却对这位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐渐敞开心扉。从城市学校到乡村社会，从误解到理解，在一片绿意中，共筑属于彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治愈、慢慢相爱。

programme.title: 君九龄
programme.desc: 九龄公主生性善良，喜好医术，一场阴谋使得她失去至亲，骨肉分离，容貌大变。为了查清真相报仇雪恨，九龄隐姓埋名一直蛰伏，靠著坚强的毅力和意志力，苦练技艺，不放过任何蛛丝马迹，最终发现这场阴谋背后还有一段不为人知的皇室辛秘。知晓真相后的九龄，回到京城，在凶手不断的骚扰和攻击中建立了医馆九龄堂，济世救人，受人尊崇。与此同时，朱瓒与清贵公子宁云钊、前夫陆云旗、方家独子方承宇，身份各异、关系复杂的四人，陷入了以九龄为核心的感情漩涡。谁才是九龄的真命天子？

programme.desc: The voice trumpet leads a game of 'I Spy' where the Teletubbies have to spot different colours - purple, green, yellow and red. What or who can they spot with those colours?

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, the adopted son of the Great Banner Sect leader, is hunted by the sect's rival for the secret to its hidden treasure. To uncover the truth, he journeys to an island seeking the "Empress of the Day", only to find her dead. There, he unexpectedly meets the sect's founder, the "Emperor of the Night", who reveals that he is Tie's biological father.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Final Key
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere tells the kids that the failed mission is over, but Tony isn’t ready to give up, and he’s determined to rescue Frostee. The crew goes rogue by deciding to steal the final key from Shashi and trade it for their friend.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ignition
programme.desc: Shashi finally reveals his master plan.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Key To The Strip
programme.desc: The kids battle Shashi in Las Vegas as Shashi tries to take down evil billionaire Cleve and use Skeleton Key to create a new world order. Frostee has a plan to get Skeleton Key offline, but it only gives Tony ten seconds to take Shashi out and save the world.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Escape from L.A.
programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. Whey they discover a mysterious man with a strange tattoo of a formula in a smuggling ring bust, Ms. Nowhere finally agrees to let them go to Rio to investigate the tattoo and the whereabouts of one of her agents who has gone dark - Layla Gray.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - That Sinking Feeling
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Hummingbird Hums
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hummingbird didn't hum. She was called Songbird and Songbird thought she could sing like a Bird… but sadly that was not the case. All the animals tried to help Songbird improve her singing but nothing worked. What could they do?! Then Tortoise has an idea, maybe Songbird can sing without opening her beak!! Songbird agrees and hums the most beautiful hum Tinga Tinga has ever heard. From that day on Songbird was called Hummingbird. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Baboon Has A Bare Bottom
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Baboon didn't have a bare bottom and he was very naughty. Baboon loved to play tricks. He played tricks on Elephant. He played tricks on Ostrich. He even dared to play tricks on Lion, the King of Tinga Tinga! And then all the animals decided it was time for the tricks to stop and Baboon to get a dose of his own medicine. Tales from Africa.

When Pat catches up with the bath he finds PC Selby about to impound it for being an un-road-worthy vehicle. Pat explains it's a Special Delivery and at last gets on his way.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Loch Ness Monster

But there is only time for Jess to roll his eyes before Pat is called out on a special delivery - it's urgent! He has to deliver the RADARSCOPE (designed by Ted) to Mrs Goggins, who is up in Scotland! Pat has no idea what a radarscope is and neither does Ben. But they know what urgent means, so they spring into action and load it into Pat's jet plane.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Cici Wins The Day

programme.desc: Cloppycorn is in charge of the Swapsy Game. Everyone puts a toy into the Swapsy Wagon and takes a toy out! It's brilliant fun - until the fairies yo yo. disappears from the wagon altogether. Cloppycorn's very upset. No one will trust him to pull the wagon again! Noddy tells him not to worry. He's going to investigate and help Cloppycorn find the missing toys.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Unhappy Unicorn
programme.desc: Cloppycorn is very upset unhappy because his special felt ball, Snuggleball, is missing. Noddy needs to investigate quickly! He follows the clues around Fable Forest and discovers that PatPat broke snuggleball by mistake when she rode over it with her scooter. Noddy asks PatPat to make a new snuggleball but Cloppycorn doesn't like it. It doesn't feel cuddly like his special toy. Clever Noddy asks everyone in Toyland to give the new snuggleball a big hug.

He finds himself going head to head with jealous Hoof who wants to prove that Noddy isn't the only investigator in Toyland. Hoof thinks he's solved the case in no time, but Noddy's attention to detail makes him realise the bandit isn't quite what he seems.

Using all his detecting skills Noddy follows the clues to the DareDale Caves where he realises that the ship on the horizon isn't Tina the Terrible's galleon at all.

programme.desc: When some pieces from Big Ears' jigsaw puzzle go missing, Noddy investigates: where are the missing pieces? But when Pat-Pat and the Pockets invite him to share a piece of toy cake, Noddy suddenly has a breakthrough: maybe it wasn't one toy who took lots of pieces but lots of toys who each took one piece.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Peacock Struts

He wanted to be the best flyer in Tinga Tinga and he wanted to have the biggest and the best tail in Tinga Tinga…. But as Lion so wisely points out ‘Sometimes it's not good to get everything you want!' Tales from Africa.

programme.desc: Queen Sparklewings is having a fairy picnic in Fable Forest that evening. Everyone offers to help set up for the picnic but Queen Sparklewings tells them not to worry - the fairies can do it all. Later, when Noddy and all his friends are approaching Fable Forest Station on the train they discover someone has redirected the train tracks. They can't get to Fable Forest. How will they have the picnic in time? Noddy needs to investigate why the train tracks have been moved.

Noddy decides to investigate: who is the mysterious King of Toyland? He spots the Knights carrying a royal litter, but all he can see inside is the top of an orange crown. Realising the King's favourite colour must be orange, Noddy remembers seeing Pat-Pat painting a bowl of oranges and wonders if she knows who the King is.

But when Noddy returns in the afternoon with Big Ears, the balloons have already flown away! Noddy decides to investigate. Following all the clues, he arrives at Deltoid's house. The action hero toy tells him that he only took back his specially decorated balloon. The others were still there earlier.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Missing Brick

How can they finish the tower without the last brick? Noddy needs to investigate. Using his detecting skills Noddy soon finds the missing brick.

Revs converts into a helicopter so that Noddy and Bumpy can fly over the rainbow to find the pot of rainbow gold. They discover that Cloppycorn has been taking the gold from the pot to give his unicorn horn a special golden glow.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Flying Toy

Realising that magic is involved, Noddy goes to see Queen Sparklewings to see if she can help but she tells him her wand has gone missing. Someone must be trying to do magic with her wand! Meanwhile more flying toys appear, first Fuse and then Smartysaurus.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Spooky Noise
programme.desc: The Naughticorns have borrowed Noddy's music player to practise a special dance for Pat-Pat's Pumpkin Party. But when Noddy arrives at the party, the other toys are all scared by a strange noise. Noddy decides to investigate: what's making the scary noise? Using his investigating skills and following all the clues, Noddy arrives at the Naughticorn Stables where he realises that the scary noise is actually a slowed down tune on the music player.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Upset Animals
programme.desc: Something upsets all the animals at the farm at night and no one can get to sleep . Farmer Tom asks Noddy to investigate before night falls so that everyone can go to sleep properly. Using his wwwbook to gather clues and using all his investigation skills Noddy travels all over Toyland to find out what has been disturbing the animals. He works out that the new stickers that PatPat gave to the the animals are made out of glow in the dark paper.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Aardvark Has A Sticky Tongue
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Aardvark didn't have a sticky tongue. He had a long nose, big clumsy paws and he found it very difficult to eat. Then one day Aardvark's tongue got stuck in the honey log! All his friends pulled and pulled until KERPLING! Aardvark's tongue finally came unstuck. From that day on Aardvark's tongue was all long and sticky - perfect for eating yummy termites. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Whale Spouts
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Whale didn't spout. Then one day there is a big storm in Tinga Tinga. The winds blew stronger and the ocean waves got bigger and bigger. Suddenly an enormous wave picks up Whale and carries her all the way from the ocean to the Waterhole. SPLOSH! But Whale was so full of water that she couldn't move! How do the animals help Whale get back to the ocean? For once, Elephant has the answer. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Space Suit
programme.desc: It's a snowy day in Greendale, and Ted Glen has invited the kids to his workshop to meet his friend, space expert Professor Farrow. Julian's excited but so is Pat, who has always yearned to be an astronaut. He's even more thrilled when he finds that his special delivery is a space suit - an extra surprise for the kids. When his van breaks down in a snowy lane, he finds an ingenious solution - only to suffer a puncture - and Ted is unable to help...

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Stormy Birthday

Noddy goes back to Toy Green to tell Big Ears all about it and narrowly misses being run over by the runaway Pirates Galleon. Someone has taken their sticky anchor and without it they've no way of stopping the ship! Noddy needs to investigate before there's an accident! He follows all the clues which leads him to the Knights.

Did the Naughticorns take them for their obstacle course? Or was it Farmer Tom who used them to keep his animals under control. Noddy carefully follows the clues and at last discovers it was the Pirates who took them to use as markers for Stripes' Pirate Galleon Driving Test.

He soon works out that Bling was in Fuse's Workshop but it turns out that she just went in to add a Special Thing to Fuse's collection. More clues lead Noddy to Smartysaurus. She admits she went into Fuse's Workshop but tripped on an oil can and fled when she saw all the mess she'd made. As for the Special Things, they'd already gone when she got there.

He realises that the grey coins are actually the gold coin covered with paint. They're not the only things that have turned grey too - Deltoid's shiny gold medal has been painted grey too.

Noddy carefully follows the clues and at last discovers it was the Pirates who took them to use as markers for Stripes' Pirate Galleon Driving Test.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Disappearing Special Things
programme.desc: When Fuse's collection of Special Things goes missing, Noddy vows to track them down. He soon works out that Bling was in Fuse's Workshop but it turns out that she just went in to add a Special Thing to Fuse's collection. More clues lead Noddy to Smartysaurus. She admits she went into Fuse's Workshop but tripped on an oil can and fled when she saw all the mess she'd made. As for the Special Things, they'd already gone when she got there.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Grey Coins
programme.desc: The Captain is upset because all of his shiny gold coins have been painted grey. It's a disaster as far as the pirates are concerned! Noddy decides to investigate. He realises that the grey coins are actually the gold coin covered with paint. They're not the only things that have turned grey too - Deltoid's shiny gold medal has been painted grey too.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - It's Purrsday!
programme.desc: It's Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Stuff Campout
programme.desc: When Kelp and Scallop discover Mr. Pearly has a cave full of stuff they help him to realize it could help a lot of other sea creatures. When the group goes camping, Kelp helps Ollie learn that even though it didn’t go exactly as planned, they can still have loads of fun.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Family Trip Great Great Grandicorn
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop help Dad discover the true meaning of family trips. When the Great Great Grandicorn comes to visit, the kids learn that making mistakes is part of learning.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Pupcakes \ Stink or Swim
programme.desc: When Tag discovers that Scooch is a great baker, she encourages him to start a pupcake stand. But when Tag rounds up more customers than Scooch is prepared to handle, Scooch can’t keep up with the demand. \ Tag and Scooch’s race to pick up the most trash on Pawston Beach is thwarted by Frank and Beans, who just want to make more of a mess.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - A Ball-For-All
programme.desc: It's Ball-entine’s Day, the day when the dogs of Pawston show their affection for each other by exchanging balls. But unfortunately, the town is fresh out, so Tag and Scooch set sail for Ball Island. \ If Tag and Scooch want to leave Ball Island with the balls they chose for their family, they must earn them by proving themselves ball-worthy, through a series of challenges from The Fetcher.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Drillasaurs
programme.desc: Half dinosaur! Half construction truck! Full-on fun! Watch giant Ty Rux, his little buddy Revvit and the crew come face-to-face with evil D-Structs.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Cousin Caper
programme.desc: Lucky and the PALs must rescue Julian after he gets in too deep while pledging a secret society at his school

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Tunnel Of Terror Creature From The Croods Lagoon
programme.desc: Eep, Thunk, Lerk, and Womp set out to make it to the end of "The Tunnel of Terror" within the Cave of Secrets; After being rescued by a mysterious creature at the watering hole, Thunk tries to convince the Valley that a "sea thing" exists and it's not just his imagination

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Voice Fail Part 1 & 2
programme.desc: When Grug wakes up without a voice, he and Ugga go on the hunt to find his voice, while Eep, Thunk, and Gran stay behind. But when the Valleyites come to Eep with questions for Grug, she takes this opportunity to be a leader by pretending to have a conversation with Grug in their cave

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - The Zippleback Experience
programme.desc: After heroes Hiccup and Toothless save Barf and Belch's life, the grateful Zippleback tries to repay its life debt and abandons riders Ruff and Tuff

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Snow Way Out
programme.desc: Determined to create a key to the Dragon Eye, Ryker heads to Glacier Island to find the dangerous Snow Wraith being protected by the Dragon Riders

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - An Uphill Battle
programme.desc: The Dragon Knights make a deal for the Storm Wheel but first must obtain the other Storm Wheel from a mysterious mad scientist. Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Mad Scientist
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blade's brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - It's Purrsday!
programme.desc: It's Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: It's time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Mega Fat
programme.desc: After Mega Fat is fired from Baby Corp;he’s forced on the path of recovery towards being a Good Baby. However;Mega Fat is more interested in getting revenge on Boss Baby than finding the perfect family to adopt him.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Halloween
programme.desc: Boss Baby uses the cover of Halloween Night to sneak into Bubeezee’s Headquarters to shut it all down. Tim covers for Boss by distracting Marisol with a night of trick or treating.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Key To The Strip
programme.desc: The kids battle Shashi in Las Vegas as Shashi tries to take down evil billionaire Cleve and use Skeleton Key to create a new world order. Frostee has a plan to get Skeleton Key offline, but it only gives Tony ten seconds to take Shashi out and save the world.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Escape from L.A.
programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. Whey they discover a mysterious man with a strange tattoo of a formula in a smuggling ring bust, Ms. Nowhere finally agrees to let them go to Rio to investigate the tattoo and the whereabouts of one of her agents who has gone dark - Layla Gray.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - That Sinking Feeling
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Crash Course
programme.desc: When a dangerous subterranean Cavern Crasher dragon invades the Fireworm Queen's underground nest, she approaches the Riders on Dragon's Edge for help.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Follow The Leader
programme.desc: When Fishlegs discovers a hidden civilization of Albino Night Terrors beneath Dragon's Edge, he must craft an escape plan after they attack the Riders.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Turn And Burn
programme.desc: Stoick, Hiccup and Snotlout search for Spitelout when he goes missing, and ultimately find him on a distant island battling a fiery Singetail dragon.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Skullcrusher
programme.desc: When Jim is imprisoned in the Darklands, Blinky tries to decipher the Amulet to save him while Claire, Toby, and NotEnrique race to recover the Killahead Bridge before it's too late

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Grand Theft Otto
programme.desc: Toby gets secret transmissions through his headgear and his friends decide they need to infiltrate; meanwhile, Jim forms an unlikely alliance

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Kanjigaargh
programme.desc: Blinky, Toby and Claire make a dangerous trade with the Janus Order while Gunmar sets Jim up in a battle to the death

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimi’s not exactly who she says she is. Our villains’ alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.
